coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 3 of 5 ground-truth variable items (60%): JaxMARL/SMAX with fixed hardware, MAPPO versus QMIX as primary algorithms, and wall-clock training time to a defined performance criterion. Reporting time in seconds rather than minutes is a convertible unit difference.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Uses only three maps instead of the required nine selected by excluding maps with more than 10 units. Normalizes scores using (score − random)/(expert − random), rather than score divided by the maximum score for each scenario.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Omits both expected findings: PPO trains approximately 6× faster than Q-Learning and achieves higher normalized scores in most SMAX scenarios due to greater training stability and more effective policy optimization.
